name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
shortDescription: Open standard connecting AI agents to tools and data; we build and run public MCP servers.
description: The Model Context Protocol is the open standard for giving AI agents structured access to tools and data. We run public MCP servers on our own properties — this site included — and build them for clients as part of agent-readiness work: search, content, and domain actions exposed to any MCP-capable agent, with authentication only where it belongs.
useCases: Public read-only MCP servers that make site content agent-consumable
Authenticated MCP tools over product APIs for customer workflows
Agent-readiness audits: discovery manifests, server cards, tool design
